steps.caption: Today's meetings are listed first. Open this one.
Jump to the Site visit checklist.
Before, during and after: tick each item as you go.
Before (confirm access, send the pack), during (check the space) and after (collect feedback).
Property feedback: one form per building visited.
Rate it and set the client's interest.
Add what they said. Only tick 'clearly rejected' if the client said no.
The building now shows the client's interest and rating.
